verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for a knowledge-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training commitment. Storing Knowledge in the user's own configured storage provider is an adjacent data-residency fact, not a control that prevents model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
